messages:
alex_support: FYI customer ACME (via maria_cs) is seeing serious long-context regression after last canary. Model is dropping system instructions halfway through multi-turn doc summarization. They say it used to follow the "always include section headers" instruction consistently.

maria_cs: Customer repro steps pasted below. They've attached a failing transcript and say this started immediately after canary rolled yesterday evening (~18:40 UTC). They want an ETA, customer is blocked for a major demo.

customer_acme: repro: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-compat-v2",
    "system": "You are a doc assistant. ALWAYS include H1/H2 headers for each section.",
    "messages": [
      {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following long spec: <very long doc ~18k chars>"}
    ],
    "max_tokens": 1500
  }'
```
Output now is missing headers, sometimes cuts off mid-sentence at ~9k tokens. Old behavior (pre-canary) included headers and coherent sectioning.

jon_eng_ml: thanks, adding logs and quick diffs. Canary build: runtime v2.6.3 -> 2.7.0. Main change: KV cache eviction heuristics and new prefix-truncation optimizer. Possible that optimizer miscalculates preserved prefix length when sequence > 8k.

ravi_oncall: can we get a concrete failing request from customer? need full request+response JSON and server logs for that session_id. Also capture pod id and model shard; ask customer for request id if present.

customer_acme: session_id: sess-9f3c, request_id: req-20260315-339, I attached the full response body and truncated tokens count. They also saw occasional 503s with "write failed" in the same timeframe.

alex_support: uploading attachments to ticket. Note: customer used pinned model version "redwood-compat-v2@2026-03-14" — they said we rolled out canary to that variant.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout to 20% completed at 2026-03-14T18:42:12Z for redwood-compat-v2@2026-03-14 (id: rollout-cc-20260314). No automated rollback.

jon_eng_ml: quick local repro: run with the customer's long input and the canary binary, KV cache trimming code emits this at token ~9200: "kv_cache_evicted breath=false count=1 reason=prefix_truncation". Older binary shows no eviction. Suspect bug in prefix length calc when using streaming + large max_tokens.

emma_prod: is this hitting hosted only or dedicated as well? Customer says hosted. We should check routing policies; if hosted fallback to cheaper variant might change token accounting.

jon_eng_ml: suspected sequence: new optimizer tries to keep a dynamic prefix but on streaming requests it used tokens_emitted instead of tokens_seen to compute retained KV, which undercounts and causes mid-doc eviction -> system prompt and earlier instructions get evicted -> lost headers.

ravi_oncall: can we hotfix? Options: revert canary, or patch prefix calc and roll quick patch. Revert is fastest to restore customer UX.

alex_support: customer needs immediate mitigation. Maria, can we offer temporary dedicated slot or pin to older runtime? Customer prefers pinned older behavior.

maria_cs: I'll offer pinned older runtime if available; asking legal for credits. Also asking customer for a minimal failing payload that we can use for a test case.

jon_eng_ml: I'll prepare a reproducer and unit test. Plan: revert the heuristic in canary (toggle flag preserve_prefix_v2=false) and push to canary traffic within 30m. If that restores behavior, we push full rollback.

ravi_oncall: oncall runway: I can coordinate rollback. Need approval from release leads. tagging @release-lead for go/no-go.

release-lead: approve emergency rollback for rollout-cc-20260314. Prioritize hosted user impact. Schedule 10-min flake window.

jon_eng_ml: rolling rollback now. Will monitor token-level diffs and customer session req-20260315-339.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 2026-03-15T02:13:04Z for rollout-cc-20260314. Target: revert variant binary to v2.6.3.

jon_eng_ml: rollback completed. I've replayed the exact payload against the reverted binary; headers are back and no kv eviction log present. Sending customer repro results.

maria_cs: Customer confirms baseline restored for their sample payload. They report no missing headers now. They're still running a full regression test suite but are unblocked for the demo.

alex_support: follow-ups: 1) ticket update with RCA 2) unit/regression test added to repo to include a long-system-prompt + streaming path 3) monitor metrics for similar regressions for next 48h. Jon, please add the failing session ids to the alerting/telemetry so we catch recurrence.

jon_eng_ml: will open PR with test + fix and add alert. Also adding an eval that checks for "ALWAYS include H1/H2" instruction compliance on long docs to Redwood Evals.

maria_cs: closing loop with customer, offering one month credit for disruption.

customer_acme: thanks for fast action, appreciate the rollback and test coverage.

alex_support: marking thread resolved but leaving logs here for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
